Subject and items are not mutually exclusive: the same explicitly named billed goods or service may support both subject and an item's description. Judge item existence separately from the completeness of its attributes. Subject needs a stated overall purpose: do not concatenate separately named items to invent an unstated subject. A list of goods alone may leave subject missing. Normalize ordinary item descriptions to nominative case when unambiguous, without changing meaning, characteristics or names in quotation marks. An item with only a supported description is fillable when the billed goods or service are unambiguously named. Fill each attribute only when supported by user messages or an unambiguous calculation from their data; leave all other attributes null. Missing quantity, unit or unit_price_rub does not make the entire items field missing or ambiguous. As a convention for this task, treat a single line item as having one unit price. Its total and positive quantity support unit_price_rub as total/count when both belong to that same line item and the dialogue does not indicate different unit prices within it. Quantity may be explicitly stated or unambiguously calculated from user data. No explicit statement of equal prices is required. A directly stated unit price needs no calculation. Do not divide a combined total for several different goods by their combined quantity to invent their individual prices. Preserve separately priced items; if their allocation is unknown, null unit prices are correct. Do not create an item from only a total amount, a recipient name or a contract reference. If no billed goods or service are named and no other item details are supplied, items is missing. For 'Счёт на 5000 рублей', amount_rub is 5000 and items is missing. For 'Счёт за консультационные услуги на 5000 рублей', items is fillable with description 'консультационные услуги' and null quantity, unit and unit_price_rub; amount_rub is 5000 and subject may be 'консультационные услуги'. For 'Абрикосы: 100 рублей за 5 штук', one line item has total=100 and quantity=5, supporting a unit price calculation of 100/5. For 'Стулья: по 3 штуки для каждого из 4 кабинетов, всего 12000 рублей', quantity is 3*4 and unit price is 12000/(3*4); both formulas must use the original source numbers. For 'Яблоки и груши: всего 5 штук на 100 рублей', do not invent each good's quantity or unit price. These examples do not supply real case values.

Subject and items are not mutually exclusive: the same explicitly named billed goods or service may support both subject and an item's description. Judge item existence separately from the completeness of its attributes. Subject needs a stated overall purpose: do not concatenate separately named items to invent an unstated subject. A list of goods alone may leave subject missing. Normalize ordinary item descriptions to nominative case when unambiguous, without changing meaning, characteristics or names in quotation marks. An item with only a supported description is fillable when the billed goods or service are unambiguously named. Fill each attribute only when supported by user messages or an unambiguous calculation from their data; leave all other attributes null. Missing quantity, unit or unit_price_rub does not make the entire items field missing or ambiguous. As a convention for this task, treat a single line item as having one unit price. Its total and positive quantity support unit_price_rub as total/count when both belong to that same line item and the dialogue does not indicate different unit prices within it. Quantity may be explicitly stated or unambiguously calculated from user data. No explicit statement of equal prices is required. A directly stated unit price needs no calculation. Do not divide a combined total for several different goods by their combined quantity to invent their individual prices. Preserve separately priced items; if their allocation is unknown, null unit prices are correct. Do not create an item from only a total amount, a recipient name or a contract reference. If no billed goods or service are named and no other item details are supplied, items is missing. For 'Счёт на 5000 рублей', amount_rub is 5000 and items is missing. Subject and items are not mutually exclusive: the same explicitly named billed goods or service may support both subject and an item's description. Judge item existence separately from the completeness of its attributes. Subject needs a stated overall purpose: do not concatenate separately named items to invent an unstated subject. A list of goods alone may leave subject missing. Normalize ordinary item descriptions to nominative case when unambiguous, without changing meaning, characteristics or names in quotation marks. An item with only a supported description is fillable when the billed goods or service are unambiguously named. Fill each attribute only when supported by user messages or an unambiguous calculation from their data; leave all other attributes null. Missing quantity, unit or unit_price_rub does not make the entire items field missing or ambiguous. As a convention for this task, treat a single line item as having one unit price. Its total and positive quantity support unit_price_rub as total/count when both belong to that same line item and the dialogue does not indicate different unit prices within it. Quantity may be explicitly stated or unambiguously calculated from user data. No explicit statement of equal prices is required. A directly stated unit price needs no calculation. Do not divide a combined total for several different goods by their combined quantity to invent their individual prices. Preserve separately priced items; if their allocation is unknown, null unit prices are correct. Do not create an item from only a total amount, a recipient name or a contract reference. If no billed goods or service are named and no other item details are supplied, items is missing. For 'Счёт на 5000 рублей', amount_rub is 5000 and items is missing. For 'Счёт за консультационные услуги на 5000 рублей', items is fillable with description 'консультационные услуги' and null quantity, unit and unit_price_rub; amount_rub is 5000 and subject may be 'консультационные услуги'. For 'Абрикосы: 100 рублей за 5 штук', one line item has total=100 and quantity=5, supporting a unit price calculation of 100/5. For 'Стулья: по 3 штуки для каждого из 4 кабинетов, всего 12000 рублей', quantity is 3*4 and unit price is 12000/(3*4); both formulas must use the original source numbers. For 'Яблоки и груши: всего 5 штук на 100 рублей', do not invent each good's quantity or unit price. These examples do not supply real case values.

Missing quantity, unit or unit_price_rub does not make the entire items field missing or ambiguous. As a convention for this task, treat a single line item as having one unit price. Its total and positive quantity support unit_price_rub as total/count when both belong to that same line item and the dialogue does not indicate different unit prices within it. Quantity may be explicitly stated or unambiguously calculated from user data. No explicit statement of equal prices is required. A directly stated unit price needs no calculation. Do not divide a combined total for several different goods by their combined quantity to invent their individual prices. Preserve separately priced items; if their allocation is unknown, null unit prices are correct. Do not create an item from only a total amount, a recipient name or a contract reference. For 'Стулья: по 3 штуки для каждого из 4 кабинетов, всего 12000 рублей', quantity is 3*4 and unit price is 12000/(3*4); both formulas must use the original source numbers.
